profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Throughout my career I have spent time on all aspects of software - from deep technical details to product architecture and software strategy.   I have seen first-hand the potential for technology to bring about positive change to an organization.  My experience has taught me that realizing this potential requires strong alignment of technology with business goals.

Using software to influence the operation and growth of an organization is my passion, and my experience and ability to deeply analyze problems gives me the breadth of knowledge and depth of understanding to translate an organization's vision into a successful technical strategy.

I am constantly curious, a problem solver, and I value integrity above all other qualities.  Nothing gives me more pleasure than being able to help others to be successful in their endeavours, and I believe that creating successful teams is the key to making a positive difference. My communication skills and principle-led leadership style allow me to understand and influence others in a meaningful way.

positions.description: Senior Software Engineer at Google Zurich. Initially part of the Maps Timeline team, then 4 years in Google Shopping.

positions.title: Lead Aviarc Architect
positions.description:
Lead Architect for Aviarc, an enterprise software development approach and platform.

In this role I strive to turn the vision for our product into a reality.  This involves, in equal parts, the technical challenge of designing innovative software, and the human challenge of forming and communicating ideas across an organization.

My responsibilities include:

•	Technical and team leadership of the Aviarc Product Team
•	Overseeing architectural decisions and implementation of new features in line with our company's goals for the product
•	Contributing to the evolving best practices around custom software delivery, including the design of new tooling and new application components 
•	Public communication of design principles and benefits of Aviarc, and interaction with technical stakeholders inside and outside our organization
•	Participation in the recruitment process and mentoring of individuals with the goal of growing a motivated and capable team that can build and support world class software

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Architecture and development of an enterprise application framework to form it into an innovative product. Worked closely with client projects built within this framework to understand and respond to their evolving needs.

During this time I lead the design and implementation of a completely new core architecture and engine implementation.  The architecture was conceived to meet the growing needs of the product and provide a platform for further development and innovation in the future.  

Key technical achievements during this time:
	• Design of engine architecture, component model, and public API
	• Design and implementation of a component-based execution framework for web applications 
	• Worked with our team to design and build a new component-based UI rendering framework that includes a declarative UI model, data binding and event systems and extensive API layers.
	• Refactored the engine to use the OSGi model to provide separation between the boundaries of application code running in the engine.
	
This period of intensive creative development yielded many technical innovations - I was the author and co-inventor on a number of patents written during this time that have been submitted and are pending approval.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Software development in a range of Web technologies for clients in industries including HR, education, and government.
  * Client engagement and requirements analysis
  * Java development and software design
  * SQL database development in commercial and open source technologies
  * HTML, CSS, JavaScript

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Custom software development and system integration for our clients across various industries.  

  * Client engagement to understand and implement software requirements in the .NET platform
  * Software design with the goal of providing solutions that perform well and remain adaptable to changing business need
  * Custom integration of financial systems
